reason: I'd take the free visit for sure, and if my toddler is happy and I can actually open my laptop for an hour, I'd pay $13 once or twice a month. It's mainly a rainy-day or work-from-home-with-a-toddler fix, not a weekly habit.
objection: Is this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? I can't tell if it's worth $13 a kid when I'll spend half the time chasing my toddler instead of getting work done, and I don't know about wifi or outlets.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that I can really work there: wifi, outlets, and a toddler area I can see from my seat. A first visit that shows it's calmer than the other places in town.
